page.overview:
Who is Ara-Nea?

Ara-Nea was a male alien who resided on Necropolis as an overseer of the scavenging there. Ara-Nea tried to swindle Rey out of her money, then kill her. When Rey realized that, his plan did not work out, and Ara-Nea was then imprisoned by his own enslaved workers.
